text.p: Abaco brokerage in Mexico City on Friday upgraded Mexico airline holding company Cintra SA de CV to buy from hold.

"Cintra's YE96 report appears to confirm the company's operational turnaround, as it continues to reflect the benefits of operating and geographic synergies created between its two subsidiaries," the company wrote in a statement. Cintra is composed of Aeromexico and Mexicana airlines.

Abaco said the company's reported 15.1 billion in 1996 revenues exceeded the brokerage's expectations by 2.7 percent. It also said the 1997 outlook looks favorable because of an improving economy, "a benign competitive climate" and lower expected fuel prices.
The company's shares were unchanged in early trading from Thursday's close of 6.18 pesos.
